name: footless climbing
description: Climbing short problems on a steep wall using only your hands. It builds upper body pulling power, lock off strength and core tension for steep climbing.
instructions: Warm up fully, and save this exercise for when you can do about 10 pull-ups.
Use a wall that leans at least 20 degrees past vertical and pick large holds.
Start hanging with bent arms and keep your core tight to control any swing.
Begin with problems of 3 or 4 hand moves and lengthen them gradually over several weeks, up to around 8.
Reach each new hold with your elbow already bent, so you never drop and swing on locked arms.
Rest fully between problems and stop while your moves are still crisp.
